unconverted.what: RSA-OAEP unwrap of data keys sealed before the migration
unconverted.why: Records written before the switch still carry RSA-wrapped keys. This reads them once and re-seals them with ML-KEM-768. Delete after the re-seal job reports zero old records.

unconverted.what: ECDSA P-256 signature check on the partner's webhook
unconverted.why: The partner signs with ECDSA until its own ML-DSA rollout. Verify only, never sign. Review again when the partner announces ML-DSA keys.
